one_line: Kubrawiya Sufi scholar from Hamadan whose visits to late 14th‑century Kashmir deepened Persianate religious and artisan links.

appearance.age_look: Late 50s, slender but composed, with a calm scholar’s posture and dignified bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high forehead, light wheatish complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed medium-length grey beard and moustache, slightly arched brows, and steady thoughtful eyes with a serene, contemplative default expression.
appearance.hair: Shoulder‑length straight hair, mostly hidden under a tall soft white turban wrapped in layered folds, with a narrow dark green cloth band around the base and a small rounded cap implied beneath.
appearance.costume: A full-length Persian‑style woollen robe (qabā) in deep indigo blue with wide sleeves and a simple front opening, worn over a light cream knee‑length under‑tunic and loose cream trousers; the robe is tied with a plain brown leather girdle at the waist, from which hangs a small cloth pouch, and he wears a dark olive‑green sleeveless wool cloak (aba) draped over his shoulders, its edges subtly woven with a narrow geometric border, along with modest dark brown leather shoes and no ostentatious jewellery beyond a simple silver ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized, worn leather-bound manuscript volume of religious and mystical writings held gently in his left hand, with a simple cloth bookmark hanging from the top.

ref_desc: Sayyid Ali Hamadani is a late‑middle‑aged, wheat‑complexioned Sufi with a grey beard, white turban, indigo robe over cream garments, olive‑green shoulder cloak, brown shoes, and a worn leather-bound manuscript book as his constant prop.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sayyid Ali Hamadani standing in a calm, dignified pose: a late‑middle‑aged Sufi scholar with an oval wheatish face, high forehead, straight nose, neat medium-length grey beard and moustache, and thoughtful, serene eyes. His shoulder‑length hair is mostly concealed beneath a tall, soft white turban wrapped in layered folds, with a narrow dark green band around its base. He wears a deep indigo blue full-length Persian robe with wide sleeves and a simple front opening, belted with a plain brown leather girdle from which a small cloth pouch hangs, over a modest light cream knee‑length under‑tunic and loose cream trousers; an olive‑green sleeveless wool cloak rests on his shoulders, edged with a subtle narrow geometric border. His footwear is simple dark brown leather shoes, and a single silver ring sits on his right hand. In his left hand he gently carries a medium-sized, worn leather-bound manuscript volume with a cloth bookmark, held as his signature scholarly prop. Show his colours clearly: indigo robe, cream inner garments, olive‑green cloak, brown belt and shoes, white turban, against a neutral background, with views that make his face, turban, robe, cloak, trousers, shoes, ring, and book easy to redraw consistently.
